caption: The payment sits in block h; block h+1 is the first confirmation at about 10 min, when the merchant ships, and block h+6 is the sixth at about 60 min. Six confirmations make a double-spend reversal much harder because the attacker must build a longer private chain.

spec.title: Payment and confirmations
spec.aria: A block diagram: the customer pays 0.0102 BTC (₹51,000) into the mempool, which is mined into block h containing the ₹50,000 item and ₹1,000 fee; block h+1 gives 1 confirmation at about 10 minutes and the merchant ships, while block h+6 gives 6 confirmations at about 60 minutes.
